title: Worship in Depth: Khushu', Tadabbur, and Istiqamah
summary: At this age, the teenager moves from 'performing' Salah to 'understanding' Salah. Khushu' is not the presence of the body but the presence of the heart. Tadabbur: reading with reflection, asking, 'What does Allah want from me in this verse?' Istiqamah: doing the small consistently is better than the great but intermittent.
try_this: This week: Choose a short surah (Al-Mulk, As-Sajdah, Ar-Rahman) — read one verse daily with a simple tafsir, and discuss: 'What does this verse say to me personally?'
reflection_prompts: Which verse touched your son's heart?
Have you noticed a change in his khushu'?
